say:1:1423433001:1.text: Thank you... sorry to drag you into this again. I'm really not cut out to lead a reconstruction project...
say:1:1423433001:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们！又麻烦了你们一次……说实在的我不太擅长主持修缮……

say:2:1423433002:1.text: I've never missed the royal city's dwarves this much in my life!
say:2:1423433002:1.source_cn: 我从来没像现在一样想念过王城的矮人！

say:3:1423433003:1.text: If only Sal'thorin could keep working with them... but that's probably just wishful thinking!
say:3:1423433003:1.source_cn: 如果萨洛克兰能继续与矮人合作修缮……唉，我也只是想想！

say:4:1423433004:1.text: You've probably got more pressing things to do. I won't keep you!
say:4:1423433004:1.source_cn: 你们应该还有别的事要忙吧，就不打扰你们了！
